item_name: Rothco G.I. Type Plastic Canteen & Pistol Belt Kit
item_short_desc: Rothco's Plastic Canteen & Pistol Belt Kit is an essential addition to your outdoor and camping gear. Crafted from heavy-duty, BPA-free plastic, the survival canteen can hold up to 1 quart of water, ensuring you stay hydrated during your adventures. The camping canteen comes with a felt-lined polyester cover that provides insulation, keeping your water cool even in warmer climates. The cover is equipped with a 2-button snap closure, offering easy access while securely holding the canteen in place.
description: Rothco's Plastic Canteen & Pistol Belt Kit is an essential addition to your outdoor and camping gear. Crafted from heavy-duty, BPA-free plastic, the survival canteen can hold up to 1 quart of water, ensuring you stay hydrated during your adventures. The camping canteen comes with a felt-lined polyester cover that provides insulation, keeping your water cool even in warmer climates. The cover is equipped with a 2-button snap closure, offering easy access while securely holding the canteen in place. Included in the kit is a durable 39 inch x 2 1/8 inch heavy web pistol belt, designed for comfortable wear and reliable performance. The canteen itself measures 4 inch x 2 inch x 5 3/4 inch to the neck and 7 1/2 inch to the top, making it compact yet effective for carrying on hikes, camping trips, and other outdoor activities. Whether you're exploring the great outdoors or preparing for an extended trip, this canteen and pistol belt kit provides the convenience and reliability you need.
